g.text: Similar early grades. Different courses of interaction.
Same scene and standard user. Identical six-level grades for the first two turns. Two observed episodes, not a causal pair.
Adjacent observations only: no smoothing or extension after stopping. P(Advance) is a forecast at that turn, not realized progress.
